problem: The pack has no feedback surface: 'toast', 'notice', 'banner', 'notification', 'feedback' all resolve UNDEFINED. The Cadence app spec demanded a floating toast; the source prefers inline notices; the consumer shipped a marked toast improvisation and recorded the tension, which canon cannot currently arbitrate.
insufficiency: Feedback representation is source-owned and accepted but unshipped: decisions.json W-15 (feedback, Gate 2 accepted) - 'Inline notices (rounded 12, tinted fill) rather than floating toasts; copy is plain, non-blaming, question-first.' The decision explicitly rejects floating toasts as unevidenced. Without the entry, a 'toast' request can only be improvised (never source-true), and consumers cannot obtain the sanctioned feedback surface.
reuse_case: Save confirmations, validation feedback, and transient state messages are universal in products; the inline-notice shape and its copy rules are reusable across consumers.
composition_check: Existing elements cannot compose it: guideline/voice gives tone only; component/card gives vessels, not a small tinted notice; token-set/colour gives fills, not notice semantics; nothing states the toast rejection; recipes.json is empty. A single pattern entry is the smallest carrier. (The weekly-summary banner composes from colour band + number display treatment; celebration motion stays outside canon - motion not evidenced.)

proposed.title: Inline notice (feedback)

states: inline notice: rounded 12, tinted fill (palette roles)
do: prefer inline notices placed near the element or content that changed

proposed.notes: Content per decisions.json W-15 (accepted). The floating toast is explicitly NOT proposed for canon; the Cadence toast remains a marked improvisation. Celebration/confetti motion likewise stays outside canon (motion not evidenced).
